title: Home
intro: What you've taken on, from all your associations and Privat. Tick it off when it's done.
docWritten: Done, and “✓ klart” is now in the document.
docLocked: Done here. Tick it off in the document too: the line was changed there, so we leave it alone.
docFailed: Done here. We couldn't write to the document just now, so tick it off there too.
saveFailed: That didn't save. Please try again.
forbidden: Only the person with the task, or an admin of the association, can tick it off.
notOpen: The meeting is still running. Tick it off in the document for now.
emptyTitle: No tasks on you right now
emptyText: When someone in a meeting says you'll take something on, it lands here with its deadline and what counts as done. Tasks given to your role (for example Treasurer) land here too.
allDoneText: You have no open tasks. Nice work!

recentEmptyText: Start a meeting in an association, or record something in Privat. Afterwards you'll see the meeting here with its decisions and tasks.
